actions.name: amorphous
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}.

actions.name: shadow stealth
actions.desc: While in &reference[dim light] or &reference[darkness], the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can take the &reference[Hide] action as a bonus action.

actions.name: strength drain
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target's Strength score is reduced by [[/r 1d4]]. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.QGcQYZbVl4bWzi4E]{shadow} rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

actions.name: sunlight sensitivity
actions.desc: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
